::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 6th [1866?][^1]  
**Manuscript:** MS Lambeth Palace Library Keble Deposit 4/143
:::

My dear [Mrs Keble](people/person_797.qmd)
How very stupid and ungrateful you must have thought me, but I never saw your [Son](people/person_799.qmd)’s letter when I opened – and answered yours, and only found it this morning.  

It satisfies me all the more as being what I was always inclined to think.

yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Written on paper used between 1864 and 1868. It seems probable that the query related to the life of [John Keble](people/person_798.qmd).
